name: config-generate-key-validation
title: Validate --config generate keys symmetric with server keys
description: _load_serve_config rejects unknown top-level 'server' keys but passes the 'generate' map through with only a type check, so a typo'd generate key is silently ignored or mismapped instead of failing loud like a server-key typo. Add a symmetric allowlist/validation for generate keys.
creator: sdelmas
